more_info.banned_in:
Banned in: United States.
FDA terminated its remaining food-use certificates for FD&C Red No. 4 in 1976.
more_info.overview: Scarlet GN is a red azo dye also named FD&C Red No. 4 and Food Red 2. It is usually described as a disodium dye salt. The older food-colour designation refers to this pigment, distinct from Natural Red 4. Its dye identity does not establish a current permitted food application; its regulatory history is recorded separately.
